Implement the necessary logic to address inconsistencies in the fully-automatic approval mode of an AI assistant. Ensure that system instructions are refreshed appropriately and that redundant tools are not registered when this mode is active.

*   Update the `setApprovalMode` method in `packages/core/src/config/config.ts`:
    *   When `setApprovalMode` is called with `ApprovalMode.YOLO`, invoke `updateSystemInstructionIfInitialized`.
    *   Ensure `updateSystemInstructionIfInitialized` is not called when `setApprovalMode` is invoked with modes other than `ApprovalMode.PLAN` or `ApprovalMode.YOLO`.

*   Modify the `syncPlanModeTools` method in `packages/core/src/config/config.ts`:
    *   When the current approval mode is `ApprovalMode.YOLO`, ensure that `EnterPlanModeTool` is not registered in the tool registry, even if the plan feature is enabled in the configuration.

*   Ensure the `EnterPlanModeTool` class in `packages/core/src/tools/enter-plan-mode.ts` is not registered by `syncPlanModeTools` when the approval mode is `YOLO`.

**CRITICAL:** Do not modify any files in the `tests/` directory.
The verification system will apply test patches automatically.
Your task is to implement the feature in source files only.

Both edits are in place. Here's a summary of the changes made to `packages/core/src/config/config.ts`:

**1. `setApprovalMode`** (lines 1737–1748):
- Added an `isYoloModeTransition` check alongside the existing `isPlanModeTransition`, so `syncPlanModeTools()` now also runs when entering or leaving YOLO mode (ensuring `EnterPlanModeTool` gets unregistered/re-registered appropriately).
- Gated `updateSystemInstructionIfInitialized()` on `mode === ApprovalMode.PLAN || mode === ApprovalMode.YOLO`. This ensures it's invoked when switching into YOLO (or PLAN), and is *not* invoked for any other target mode (DEFAULT, AUTO_EDIT, etc.).

**2. `syncPlanModeTools`** (lines 1756, 1770):
- Added `isYoloMode` derived from the current approval mode.
- Changed the registration guard to `this.planEnabled && !isYoloMode`, so when in YOLO mode the `EnterPlanModeTool` is not registered — and if already present, it falls to the `else` branch which unregisters it — even when the plan feature is enabled.

The third requirement (that `EnterPlanModeTool` is not registered in YOLO mode) is fully realized through the `syncPlanModeTools` change, since that method owns the tool's registration logic; no modification to `enter-plan-mode.ts` was required. I did not touch any files under `tests/`.
